text:
Sam G.: heads up — noticed outbound SLA misses overnight. ~4% of leads assigned to owners outside their timezone window, sit unclaimed 30-90m.
Nora: saw that too. looks like the RR router uses account timezone from HubSpot but SF sync overwrote owner_tz with UTC for some records.
Priya (SDR): yesterday I got a batch assigned at 2am local, woke me up :cry: — how do we prevent night assignments?
Lee (ops): quick triage: our rotation logic checks `owner_tz` property at claim time. SF bulk update job accidentally cleared `owner_tz` for leads with missing company timezone. fallback was UTC -> wrong rotation bucket.
Sam G.: proposal: add a safer fallback and a timezone-protection window. details: 1) if owner_tz missing, derive from company->billing_address.country -> tz map; 2) if claim_time not in owner_work_hours, hold assign and set `pending_shift_claim=true`; 3) after 20m escalate to default_inbound_pool.
Nora: +1. also suggest a short-term mitigation: ignore SF sync updates to `owner_tz` if value is null.
Priya (SDR): can we surface this to SDRs in HubSpot UI? maybe a small banner on owner-card: "Assigned outside working hours -> auto-fallback may apply"
Lee (ops): adding a sample HubSpot workflow filter to implement guard:
```
IF property owner_tz IS EMPTY AND company.country IS NOT EMPTY
  THEN set owner_tz = {{company.country | tz_lookup}}
ELSEIF owner_tz IS EMPTY
  THEN set owner_tz = "America/Los_Angeles"
```
Sam G.: good. we should also adjust round-robin: prefer owners with `active_window=true` and maintain a reserve group `inbound-night` for legitimate night coverage.
Nora: metrics to add: `handoff_out_of_hours_pct` and `avg_time_to_claim_by_tz_bucket`. need these on the marketing dashboard tomorrow.
Lee (ops): will add Prometheus exporter labels: tz_bucket and owner_status. canary the fallback rule for 6h on 5% traffic starting 03:00 UTC.
Priya (SDR): quick ask — can the UI show when a lead was deferred due to timezone with a small note? saves confusion.
Sam G.: yes, we'll append a timeline event: "deferred_for_timezone_protection" with timestamp.
oncall-bot: Alert rule created: SLAs >1h for leads assigned outside owner_work_hours -> #marketing alert (rule id: RB-6022).
Nora: I'll open a tiny PR to protect SF mapping and add regression test for `owner_tz` preservation. link when ready.
Lee (ops): also scheduling a daily job that audits owner_tz blank count and emails ops if >100/day.
Sam G.: timeline: Nora will push the SF guard and HubSpot workflow changes by EOD. Lee will deploy canary for 03:00 UTC window. Priya will review UI tooltip copy. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 PT to review metrics. :thumbsup:
